lessons.title: Put a chapter in the book

blocks.body: You just named today's job. Now the idea: Put a chapter in the book. Then you will do the lab.

blocks.heading: Put a chapter in the book
blocks.body:
Right-click in Maps Manager → **Append Child** → point at a page.

You did not copy the words into the booklet. You added a pointer.

blocks.alt: New document wizard in Oxygen XML Editor
blocks.caption: File > New. Pick a file type here. On day 1 you only need a blank project, not this wizard yet.
blocks.credit: Oxygen XML Editor User Guide, Syncro Soft

blocks.lead: Open a heading only if you want extra detail on that point.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **topicref** :  one line in the booklet that points at a page (a topic file). You can say “a pointer” out loud. Same thing.

blocks.lead: Flip each card. The front is a word from this lesson. The back is what it means here.

cards.back: one line in the booklet that points at a page (a topic file). You can say “a pointer” out loud. Same thing

blocks.title: DITA Maps Manager View in Oxygen XML Editor 19
watchFor: A new line in the tree

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Append one page.

This lab can fail. Fail when: The page exists on disk but is not in the tree, or the new line does not open the page.

Expected: The tree shows your page. Clicking it opens the file.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Append one page.
blocks.intro: How to Append one page. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Append one page
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy your week2 explaining page into samples/flower-docs/topics/ if it is not already there (or point at oxygen-bootcamp-work/week2/ if your map can see it). Keep the file name lowercase with hyphens.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: In Maps Manager, right-click a heading (or the map root) > Append Child > Reference. Point at that page.

image.alt: New document wizard in Oxygen XML Editor
image.caption: File > New. Pick a file type here. On day 1 you only need a blank project, not this wizard yet.
image.credit: Oxygen XML Editor User Guide, Syncro Soft

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Click the new line. The page should open.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Do not rename files in the folder without updating the booklet. That is a later day.

blocks.summary: The tree shows your page. Clicking it opens the file.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
options: A pointer from the booklet to a page file
A second copy of the words inside the map
blocks.why: The new line is a pointer. The words still live in the topic file.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: The page is on disk but missing from the tree. Is it in the booklet?
blocks.why: On disk is not in the booklet. The tree is what counts.
